controls.regle: The level of compliance with the WCAG 2.2 level AA success criteria (or the applicable local accessibility standards package) is measured through a tooled and documented audit, with a remediation plan for any unmet criterion.
controls.verification: Run a tooled accessibility audit covering the full set of WCAG 2.2 level AA success criteria (or the declared local standards package) on the main journeys, and verify the existence of a remediation plan for the gaps.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated accessibility audit report (score per success criterion) + remediation plan for the identified gaps.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% of the AA criteria met or documented waiver ; partial = gaps identified with a dated remediation plan ; non-compliant = no accessibility audit performed or gaps without a remediation plan
actions_audit: Run (or have replayed) a tooled accessibility audit on the main journeys and collect the score per success criterion.
Verify the existence of a dated remediation plan for each unmet criterion.
If a gap is found: prioritize the remediation according to the criterion's criticality (blocking for use vs. comfort).
standards: WCAG 2.2 — niveau AA (ensemble des critères de succès)

controls.regle: All functional journeys are fully operable with the keyboard alone, without a focus trap, with a visible focus indicator at every step.
controls.verification: Walk through the declared critical journeys using only the keyboard (tab, enter, escape) and verify the absence of a focus trap and the continuous visibility of the focus indicator.
controls.preuve_attendue: Recording or report of the keyboard navigation on each critical journey, with the blocking points identified.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all critical journeys operable with the keyboard, focus always visible ; partial = secondary journeys not operable with the keyboard ; non-compliant = focus trap or element unreachable by keyboard on a critical journey
actions_audit: Replay each declared critical journey using keyboard-only navigation.
Verify the absence of a focus trap and the continuous visibility of the focus indicator.
If a gap is found: fix the tab order or the components inaccessible by keyboard.

controls.regle: The color contrasts of text and significant interface elements meet the required minimum ratios, verified with a contrast measurement tool across the full set of screens in the style guide.
controls.verification: Measure the contrast ratio of text and significant interface elements (icons, input fields) on each representative screen of the style guide, using a contrast measurement tool.
controls.preuve_attendue: Contrast measurement report per representative screen, with the ratios obtained against the required threshold.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all ratios measured above the required threshold ; partial = gaps limited to non-essential elements ; non-compliant = essential text or element below the required threshold
actions_audit: Measure the contrast ratio on each representative screen (normal text, large text, non-text elements).
Isolate the elements below the required threshold and assess how essential they are to the journey.
If a gap is found: adjust the style guide's color palette for the affected elements.

controls.regle: The interface adapts without loss of functionality or readability to the screen widths and interaction modes (touch, mouse, keyboard) of the declared target devices.
controls.verification: Verify the rendering and operability of the main journeys on each declared target device (desktop, tablet, mobile), in portrait and landscape modes where applicable.
controls.preuve_attendue: Screenshots of the main journeys on each target device + record of the layout breakpoints.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = main journeys operable and readable on all target devices ; partial = layout breakage limited to secondary screens ; non-compliant = critical journey inoperable on a declared target device
actions_audit: List the declared target devices and verify the rendering of the main journeys on each.
Identify the layout breakpoints or points of functionality loss.
If a gap is found: fix the breakpoints and extend the tests to the uncovered devices.

controls.regle: The performance perceived by the user (initial load time, responsiveness to interactions, visual stability) is measured with a generic web or mobile performance measurement tool, on the main journeys.
controls.verification: Run a generic performance measurement tool on the main journeys and record the perceived performance indicators (initial load, responsiveness, visual stability) in a representative environment.
controls.preuve_attendue: Perceived performance measurement report per journey, with the values obtained against the declared target thresholds.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = perceived performance indicators under the target thresholds on all main journeys ; partial = overrun limited to secondary journeys ; non-compliant = no measurement performed or thresholds exceeded on a main journey
actions_audit: Run the perceived performance measurement on each main journey in an environment representative of the target load.
Compare the indicators obtained to the declared target thresholds.
If a gap is found: identify the optimization areas (resource weight, server response time) and prioritize addressing them.

controls.regle: Every critical functional journey is tested with representative users before broad rollout, and the observed friction points are subject to a correction plan.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of user test sessions on each declared critical journey, with participants representative of the target personas, and the existence of a correction plan for the observed friction points.
controls.preuve_attendue: Report of the user test sessions (participants, journeys tested, friction points observed) + dated correction plan.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all critical journeys tested with representative users and correction plan tracked ; partial = tests performed on part of the critical journeys ; non-compliant = no user test performed
actions_audit: Verify the coverage of the user test sessions against the critical journeys declared in D00.
Assess the representativeness of the participants against the target personas.
If a gap is found: schedule the missing test sessions and track the correction plan for the friction points already observed.

controls.regle: Every error message presented to the user identifies the nature of the problem and proposes a concrete resolution or workaround action, without exposing internal technical detail.
controls.verification: Trigger the common user errors on the main journeys (invalid input, network failure, insufficient rights) and verify that each message identifies the problem and proposes a concrete action.
controls.preuve_attendue: Captures of the error messages obtained for each scenario tested, with an assessment of how actionable they are.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = all messages tested identify the problem and propose a concrete action ; partial = generic messages without a proposed action on certain scenarios ; non-compliant = raw technical message or absence of a message shown to the user
actions_audit: Trigger the common error scenarios on the main journeys and collect the messages shown.
Assess each message against two criteria: problem identification, concrete action proposed.
If a gap is found: rephrase the generic or technical messages into actionable messages.

controls.regle: A mechanism for collecting user feedback (satisfaction, friction, suggestion) is in place on an ongoing basis, and the feedback collected feeds a prioritized improvement backlog.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a user feedback collection mechanism active on an ongoing basis and its traceability to a prioritized improvement backlog.
controls.preuve_attendue: Export of the user feedback collected over a representative period + excerpt of the corresponding improvement backlog.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = collection mechanism active on an ongoing basis and feedback tracked in a prioritized backlog ; partial = one-off collection without traceability to a backlog ; non-compliant = no user feedback collection mechanism
actions_audit: Verify the existence and ongoing activity of the user feedback collection mechanism.
Trace a sample of collected feedback through to its handling in the improvement backlog.
If a gap is found: implement the collection mechanism and its connection with the product backlog.
